strengths_deep_dive: SAMS demonstrates exceptional direct delivery capacity in high-urgency conflict zones. In FY2024, <cite id="3">95.4% of expenses supported direct healthcare programs</cite>, outperforming the global health peer median of 87.4%. The organization maintains <cite id="1">4.6 months of working capital reserves</cite>, ensuring strong operational resilience during humanitarian emergencies. Additionally, fundraising efforts remain extraordinarily efficient, costing <cite id="1">just $0.01 per $1 raised</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: The Syrian American Medical Society (SAMS) Foundation is a medical relief organization providing direct care and psychosocial support in crisis zones [4]. Operating since <cite id="1">1998</cite>, SAMS delivers vital healthcare services in Syria, Jordan, Lebanon, Turkey, Greece, and Gaza. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">$61,395,982 in total revenue</cite> to support mobile clinics, trauma units, and specialized medical programs. While overall multi-year revenue showed historical growth, revenue declined 39% in the most recent year from $99,929,862 in FY2023 to $61,395,982 in FY2024 [3]. Financial efficiency remains high, with <cite id="3">a program expense ratio of 95.6%</cite> in FY2024, which easily exceeds the 75% industry standard. The charity maintains <cite id="2">zakat-eligible programs</cite> tailored to support vulnerable, displaced populations [2]. SAMS operates with strong financial management, spending just <cite id="1">$0.02 to raise every dollar</cite>.
